result.title: Conversational Generalized Linear Bandits with Hybrid Feedback
result.summary: Conversational bandits improve recommendations by actively querying users about key-terms to elicit their item preferences. However, existing methods typically assume homogeneous feedback for items and key-terms, using either absolute rewards or pairwise comparisons. In practice, item feedback often takes the form of clicks or ratings, while comparisons are more natural for key-terms. To address this gap, we study conversational generalized linear bandits with hybrid feedback, combining absolute item rewards and relative key-term comparisons. We propose Conversational UCB with Hybrid Feedback (HyConUCB), which constructs unified confidence bounds from heterogeneous feedback and adaptively selects key-term comparisons by balancing information gain and directional coverage. Through a refined regret analysis that jointly exploits both feedback sources, we establish a regret bound that improves upon reward-only and adapted dueling-only benchmarks. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

AI.brief_summary: 研究混合反馈的对话式广义线性 bandit：物品端使用绝对奖励、关键词端使用成对比较，提出 HyConUCB，从异质反馈构造统一置信界并自适应选择关键词比较，给出优于纯奖励与纯比较基线的 regret 界。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是推荐系统 bandit 的理论分析，但其在不确定性下按信息增益与覆盖度主动选取查询对象的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中主动获取视觉证据、选择证据来源与获取成本权衡的问题表述。
